title.en: Fish Market Orders and Dispatch Assistant
title.zh: 鱼市场订单与发货助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Match prepared products to approved order labels and reconcile product weights and ice-pack counts separately.
requirements.zh: 将已准备产品与获批订单标签匹配，并分别核对产品重量及冰袋数量。

requirements.en: Maintain collection records and refer incomplete labels or collection exceptions to the supervisor.
requirements.zh: 维护取货记录，并将不完整标签或取货异常转交主管。

requirements.en: Maintain clean packing supplies and clear end-of-shift order records under supplied procedures.
requirements.zh: 按所提供流程维护清洁包装用品及清晰的班末订单记录。
